title: Tuning Levers by Root Cause
summary: Define success signals, analyze agent failures using logs and traces, classify root causes, and tune instructions, memory, and tool access based on evidence.

items: **Reasoning error** → Revise instructions to be more precise; add examples of correct reasoning
**Tool misuse** → Update instructions with exact expected format; add tool-level input validation
**Dropped constraint** → Re-add explicitly; enforce mechanically via tool permissions
**Context drift** → Add pruning rules; reduce memory scope; add checkpoints
**Over-fetching** → Narrow tool access scope; revise instructions to fetch only relevant data

blocks.text: **Tuning Side Effects:** Every change must be re-evaluated against ALL success criteria. Fixing one metric can break another. Always run full regression after tuning.
